column2: {c4}Toru{c0}||A university student living in the capital region. He is 172 cm tall and weighs 60 kg, with an average build. He met Mari at the university, but they don't quite feel like an official couple yet.

{c4}Mari{c0}||A student at Toru's university, the same age. 165 cm, with a model's figure and long straight hair that suits her. Athletic and quick-witted. She is Mr. Kobayashi's niece, and that connection is how she came to the inn.
{c4}Jiro Kobayashi{c0}||Owner of the inn "Spur". He quit his office job a few years ago and started running it. Around 45, thin. He cooks most of the inn's meals himself, and he is good at it.
{c4}Kyoko Kobayashi{c0}||The owner's wife. A friendly, caring woman. Small, but a solid support for Mr. Kobayashi from within. Not good at cooking.
{c4}Toshio Kubota{c0}||Works part-time at the inn and claims to be a sixth-year university student. 184 cm, athletic build, loves skiing. Dresses like an athlete too.
{c4}Midori Shinozaki{c0}||A part-timer who lives and works at the inn. In her twenties, average build. Round face, with her hair tied back in a ponytail.
{c4}Keiko Kitano{c0}||One of the three office ladies. A little plump, but cute and charming. Seems to look forward to the food more than the skiing.
{c4}Kanako Watase{c0}||A thin woman with long hair. Her face is pretty enough to call her a beauty, but she gives a somewhat frivolous impression. Her clothes are flashy.
{c4}Aki Kawamura{c0}||One of the three office ladies, a girl with a boyish air. Like the other two she is 18, but partly because of her clothes she looks younger than her age.
{c4}Seiichi Kayama{c0}||A company president from Osaka. Mr. Kobayashi was once looked after by him at work. Thinning hair, heavyset, with a big belly sticking out.
{c4}Haruko Kayama{c0}||Seiichi Kayama's wife. A classic Japanese beauty with an oval face. Tall, and in contrast to her husband, an elegant lady. Quiet and unobtrusive.
{c4}Ichiro Tanaka{c0}||Age and occupation both unknown. Wears a coat over a dark suit and sunglasses, an outfit that is completely out of place at a ski resort.
{c4}Yosuke Mikimoto{c0}||A freelance photographer who specializes in landscapes. Tall at 185 cm, with a sturdy build. Bearded, he looks every bit the mountain man.
“Kamaitachi no Yoru” takes place at an inn in the mountains.
You, the protagonist, have come here with your partner to enjoy skiing.
Can you solve the case and leave the inn safely...?
As the story goes on, “choices” will appear.
Whichever one you pick, the story changes in many ways depending on it.
If you choose well, the “culprit name entry screen” will appear.
Enter the name of the person you think is the murderer.
Whether what follows is a tragedy or a happy ending depends on your deductions.
If you reach a tragic ending... or want to redo a choice from back then, use the movement map and restart from the scene you're curious about.
You can open the movement map at any time while reading by pressing the ф button.
“Kamaitachi no Yoru” uses a multi-scenario system, so many stories (endings) are prepared.
What kind of story unfolds after you name the culprit, see for yourself.
Now, enjoy the world of the sound novel “Kamaitachi no Yoru” to the fullest.
